units: x_pct / y_pct: percent of the image from the top-left
note: e12_a000 equals exploded-spin frame 1 and the last explode frame. Azimuth turns the glasses about the vertical; elevation is the camera's height angle (negative = from below). Anchors are the same 3D points as exploded-spin; visible is false when the anchor area is occluded or faces away.
